mla_census.verification_level: Model configuration, matched installed Python source hashes, and graph kernel geometry; runtime pointer aliases, write regions and adversarial numerical invariants were not qualified
mla_census.weight_format: Marlin uint8b128 INT8, group 128, int32 packed weights, BF16 scales, FP32 reduction
mla_census.padding: N aligned to 256 and K unpadded; no extra N/K padding for these two projections
mla_census.rounding: Native QKV-A BF16; normalized q_c and kv_c_normed BF16; Q-B BF16 output
mla_census.aliases_and_mutations: Source-derived: q_c/kv_lora initially split views of QKV-A; normalizations materialize separate tensors; Q-B output is viewed as heads. q_c remains required by the indexer; workspace mutations remain outside this qualification.
mla_census.rope_and_boundaries: No MLA Q/K-RoPE arithmetic at width zero; indexer positional operations stay outside fusion
mla_census.fallback_contract: Prefill, mixed requests and unqualified shapes must retain E36
mla_census.exact_marlin_cpp_provenance: unresolved; no matching C++ source found in inspected image build locations; no substitute used

attribution.full_target_graph_marker: 84 fused_moe_kernel short names in one GPU correlation group
attribution.mla_tuple: Marlin grid(48,1,1) block(256,1,1); RMS q grid(m,1,1) block(192,1,1); RMS KV grid(m,1,1) block(64,1,1); Marlin same grid/block; consecutive graph nodes, same stream

joint.method: Equal-length ordered synchronous target graphs; unanimous shape and phase; all four ranks must pass attribution and boundary guards. Sum eleven per-layer rank maxima for the optimistic bound; max rank graph span for denominator. Q-B GEMM excluded.
joint.interpretation: Descriptive retained-subset bound, not a candidate speedup or confidence interval; one profiled execution, timestamp exclusions may select by shape.

attribution.percentiles: p50 median; p99 observed nearest index round((n-1)*0.99), no interpolation
attribution.phase_guard: One second empirical guard plus pre/post SSH midpoint clock uncertainty; stdout delay and clock drift between probes are unbounded
attribution.removable_time: Sum of eleven layerwise maximum rank intervals from QKV-A end to Q-B start; optimistically includes both RMSNorms and gaps, assumes zero fusion/materialization cost. Q-B GEMM excluded; max rank target graph span is an optimistic denominator.
limits: One profiled execution, no independent repeats or paired 95% candidate interval
Four ranks are one synchronized observation, not four replicates
Timestamp exclusions are shape-dependent; retained-subset bounds are not universal bounds
Profiler overhead and between-execution request variation are confounded
Sparse drain cells with 1-3 retained graphs do not support tail inference

publication: Portable numeric extract; raw site-specific native receipts, profiles and graph identities retained privately; no promotion or baseline replacement
